description: This file is a PHP-based web page for device discovery and UPnP configuration in a network management interface. It includes PHP code for configuration parameter retrieval, HTML for structure, and JavaScript for client-side interactivity.

methods.name: saveQoS
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to save UPnP configuration settings.

methods.name: enableHandle
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on UPnP switch state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the UPnP and Zero Config switches and form validation.
